description: This file defines an interface 'Expression' representing an expression with a prefix and name, including methods for accessing the prefix, supported names, and support testing.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: An interface representing an expression with a prefix and a name, supporting methods to access these components and check support for a given name.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix part of the expression.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of names supported by this expression for substitution.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given name is supported by this expression.
